reauth_confirm.title: i-Vent Reauthentication
reauth_confirm.description: Please re-enter your API key to refresh the connection.

reconfigure.title: i-Vent Reconfiguration
reconfigure.description: Choose the (new) mode for this location.

user.title: i-Vent Smart Home
user.description: Choose how the integration should work.

cloud.title: i-Vent cloud
cloud.description: Enter the API key and the location ID from the i-Vent web interface ({api_url}). An API key is valid for one location only and the official API has no location list, so enter the location ID yourself (the number in the location URL, e.g. …/live/123).

hybrid.title: Combined: cloud
hybrid.description: Enter the API key ({api_url}). You can leave the location ID empty: local Master discovery determines it (it is the same in the cloud). You will then set up the local connection. State and commands go local; the cloud is used for schedules and as a write fallback.

local.title: Local connection
local.description: Enter the Location Master address. Fields left empty are discovered automatically by listening for the broadcast (a few seconds). On networks without broadcast (e.g. Docker bridge) enter IP and MAC manually.

data_description.location_id: The only credential of the local protocol; do not share it. It equals the cloud location ID.

error.auth_error: Authentication error. Check your API key.
error.cannot_connect_local: The Master does not respond. Check IP, MAC and location ID.
error.discovery_failed: The Master could not be discovered. Enter IP, MAC and location ID manually.
error.location_mismatch: The discovered Master belongs to a different location.
error.port_in_use: UDP port 1028 is in use. Close the other application using it.
error.location_id_required: The location ID is required: locations cannot be listed automatically (an API key is valid for one location). Enter the location ID.

abort.single_local_entry: Local control is possible for one location only (one UDP socket per host).

data.info_fallback: State from cloud when the Master is unreachable

data_description.info_fallback: When the local connection drops, state is read from the cloud. Off: entities become unavailable.
